$comment: Grants a BC café may qualify for. Every row carries verifiedAt and the funder's own URL. Anything unverified for two quarters is hidden rather than shown stale — a café that misses a deadline on our bad data is the one failure mode here that actually costs them money. See docs/SPEC.md, 'Grants and rebates database'.

grants.name: Canada Summer Jobs
grants.amountRange: Up to 50% of provincial minimum wage per student (small businesses)

grants.name: Futurpreneur start-up financing + mentoring
eligibility: Business under 12 months old or pre-launch

grants.name: CleanBC Business energy-efficiency rebates
grants.amountRange: Varies by measure — refrigeration, lighting, HVAC
eligibility: BC Hydro or FortisBC commercial account

grants.name: Student Work Placement Program wage subsidy
grants.amountRange: Up to 50% of wages, to $5,000 (70%/$7,000 for under-represented students)
eligibility: Hiring a post-secondary student into a paid placement
